name: Manual Testing and ISTQB Certification
certifications: ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) v4.0

beginner.summary: For new testers, graduates and people moving into QA, aligned with the ISTQB Certified Tester Foundation Level v4.0 syllabus. Covers why testing is needed, the seven principles, test activities and testware, testing in sequential and agile lifecycles, test levels and types, static testing and reviews, black-box, white-box and experience-based techniques, collaboration-based approaches, test cases, defect reports, planning, estimation, risk-based testing, monitoring, configuration management and tools, with a CTFL mock exam.
prerequisites: Comfortable using web and mobile applications
Good written English for test cases and defect reports
outcomes: Design test cases with black-box, white-box and experience-based techniques
Write clear test cases and defect reports and run a test cycle by hand
Plan, estimate and prioritise testing with risk in mind
Pass the ISTQB CTFL v4.0 exam (40 questions in 60 minutes, 26 to pass)

days.topic: Manual Testing and ISTQB Overview: Roles, Certification Path and Course Setup
subtopics: What testers do in software teams
Manual testing compared with test automation
Careers in testing: tester, test analyst, test lead and SDET
The ISTQB scheme: Foundation, Advanced and Specialist
The CTFL v4.0 syllabus and its six chapters
Exam format: 40 questions, 60 minutes, 26 marks to pass
days.lab_task: Explore the course application for thirty minutes, list ten things that look wrong, take a baseline quiz of twenty CTFL questions and plan your study weeks.
days.deliverable: Exploration notes, baseline quiz result and study plan
checks: Ten observations are recorded with steps
The quiz score is recorded by chapter
The study plan covers all six chapters before the mock exam
objectives: Describe the ISTQB scheme and exam

days.topic: Why Testing Is Necessary: Errors, Defects, Failures and Root Causes
subtopics: Real failures and what they cost
days.lab_task: Analyse three real software failures, separate error, defect, failure and root cause for each, and answer fifteen chapter 1 questions.
days.deliverable: Failure analyses and practice results
checks: Each case names error, defect, failure and root cause correctly
Each analysis states how testing could have helped
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: The Seven Testing Principles
subtopics: Testing shows the presence, not the absence, of defects
Early testing saves time and money
Applying the principles to real decisions
days.lab_task: Match each principle to a situation from a project case, explain one decision each principle should change and answer fifteen principle questions.
days.deliverable: Principle mapping and practice results
checks: Each principle is matched to a case situation
Each principle changes one testing decision
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Test Activities, Testware and Traceability
subtopics: Traceability between test basis and tests
Essential skills and the whole-team approach
days.lab_task: For a small feature, produce the testware of each activity from test conditions to a completion report, and build a traceability matrix from requirements to tests and defects.
days.deliverable: Testware set and traceability matrix
checks: Every requirement links to at least one test
The completion report summarises results and lessons

days.topic: Testing in the Software Development Lifecycle: Sequential, Iterative and Agile Models
subtopics: Sequential models such as waterfall and V-model
Good testing practice in any lifecycle
Test-first approaches: TDD, ATDD and BDD
days.lab_task: Compare testing activities in a V-model project and a Scrum project, describe how shift-left changes each, and answer fifteen chapter 2 lifecycle questions.
days.deliverable: Lifecycle comparison and practice results
checks: Testing activities are mapped for both lifecycles
Shift-left changes are described with examples
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Test Levels: Component, Integration, System and Acceptance
subtopics: Acceptance testing: user, operational, contractual and regulatory
Objectives, test basis and defects at each level
days.lab_task: Define the objectives, test basis, typical defects and owners for each test level of the course application, and design two acceptance tests with a business user.
days.deliverable: Test level table and two acceptance tests
checks: Each level has objectives, basis, defects and owner
Acceptance tests are written with a business user
At least eleven of fifteen level questions are correct

days.topic: Test Types, Confirmation Testing and Regression Testing
days.lab_task: After a set of fixes and a change to the course application, run confirmation tests, choose a regression set using impact analysis and record the results.
days.deliverable: Confirmation results, regression selection and impact analysis
checks: Each fixed defect has a confirmation test result
The regression set is justified by impact analysis
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Static Testing: Reviews, Walkthroughs and Inspections
subtopics: Static testing compared with dynamic testing
Work products that can be reviewed
Review types: informal, walkthrough, technical review and inspection
days.lab_task: Review a requirements document and five user stories with a checklist in a role-played technical review, log the findings and answer fifteen static testing questions.
days.deliverable: Review log and practice results
checks: At least ten findings are logged with locations
Review roles are assigned and followed
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Equivalence Partitioning and Boundary Value Analysis in Practice
subtopics: Black-box techniques and when to use them
days.lab_task: Design tests for an age field, a discount rule and a password policy using partitions and boundaries, run them on the course application and solve ten technique questions.
days.deliverable: Designed tests, results and practice answers
checks: Valid and invalid partitions are complete for each rule
Boundary values match two-value or three-value analysis
At least eight of ten technique questions are correct

days.topic: Decision Table Testing and State Transition Testing
subtopics: Decision tables: conditions, actions and rules
All states, valid transitions and all transitions coverage
days.lab_task: Build a decision table for a loan approval rule and a state model for an order, derive tests for each coverage level and solve ten technique questions.
days.deliverable: Decision table, state model, tests and practice answers
checks: All rules are covered with expected actions
The state model includes invalid transitions
At least eight of ten questions are correct

days.topic: White-Box Testing: Statement and Branch Coverage
subtopics: Why branch coverage includes statement coverage
Value of white-box testing for testers
days.lab_task: Calculate statement and branch coverage for five pseudocode examples, design the minimum tests for full branch coverage and solve ten coverage questions.
days.deliverable: Coverage calculations and minimum test sets
checks: Coverage percentages are correct for all five examples
Minimum test sets achieve full branch coverage
At least eight of ten questions are correct

days.topic: Experience-Based Techniques: Error Guessing, Exploratory and Checklist-Based Testing
days.lab_task: Run two time-boxed exploratory sessions on the course application with charters, use a checklist on one feature, log the defects found and compare them with scripted test results.
days.deliverable: Session notes, checklist results and defect comparison
checks: Each session has a charter, notes and findings
The checklist run records pass and fail items
New defects found by exploration are listed

days.topic: Collaboration-Based Test Approaches: User Stories, Acceptance Criteria and ATDD
days.lab_task: Refine three user stories with a role-played product owner and developer, write acceptance criteria in both formats and turn them into ATDD examples.
days.deliverable: Refined stories, criteria and ATDD examples
checks: Each story meets the INVEST criteria
Each story has testable acceptance criteria
ATDD examples cover main and edge cases

days.topic: Writing Manual Test Cases and Test Scenarios
subtopics: Maintaining test cases as features change
Test cases in a test management tool
days.lab_task: Write scenarios and twenty detailed test cases for checkout in a test management tool, have a peer review them and run them against the course application.
days.deliverable: Reviewed test cases with execution results
checks: Each case has preconditions, steps, data and expected results
All twenty cases are run with results recorded

days.topic: Defect Reports: Writing, Severity, Priority and Life Cycle
subtopics: Contents of a good defect report
The defect life cycle and states
days.lab_task: Report five defects found in the course application with steps, evidence, severity and priority, take them through the life cycle with a role-played developer and answer ten defect questions.
days.deliverable: Five defect reports and practice results
checks: Each report reproduces the defect on first try
Severity and priority are justified separately
At least eight of ten questions are correct

days.topic: Test Planning, Estimation and Test Prioritisation
subtopics: Purpose and contents of a test plan
Entry and exit criteria and definitions of ready and done
Estimation techniques: ratios, extrapolation, Wideband Delphi and three-point
Test case prioritisation: risk, coverage and requirements based
days.lab_task: Write a one-page test plan for a release with entry and exit criteria, estimate testing effort with two techniques, prioritise the test cases and answer fifteen planning questions.
days.deliverable: Test plan, estimates, priority order and practice results
checks: Scope, approach, criteria and schedule are covered
Two techniques give estimates with stated assumptions
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: Risk-Based Testing and Test Monitoring
days.lab_task: Run a product risk analysis for the course application, focus testing on the highest risks, report progress halfway through with metrics and propose one control action.
days.deliverable: Risk analysis, progress report and control action
checks: Each risk has likelihood, impact and test response
The report shows progress, defects and residual risk
The control action follows from the metrics

days.topic: Configuration Management and Test Tools
subtopics: Versions of test objects and environments
Tool types: management, static, design, execution, non-functional and DevOps
Benefits and risks of test automation
Selecting a tool with a pilot
days.lab_task: Set up version tracking for test cases and environments in a test management tool, compare three test tool types for a project, and answer fifteen questions on configuration management and tools.
days.deliverable: Configuration record, tool comparison and practice results
checks: Test cases record the build and environment they ran on
Benefits and risks are listed for three tool types
At least eleven of fifteen questions are correct

days.topic: CTFL Mock Exam and Review
subtopics: K1, K2 and K3 question styles
days.lab_task: Sit a full CTFL sample exam under exam conditions, review every wrong answer by chapter and K-level, and revise the two weakest chapters.
days.deliverable: Mock exam result, error log and revision notes
checks: The exam is completed in sixty minutes
Wrong answers are grouped by chapter and K-level

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Manual Test Cycle and CTFL Readiness Check
days.lab_task: Run a full manual test cycle on a new feature of the course application from plan to completion report, then sit a second mock exam and decide whether you are ready to book CTFL.
days.deliverable: Test cycle artefacts, second mock result and readiness decision
checks: Plan, tests, defects and completion report are complete
Tests show at least three design techniques
The decision is based on both mock scores

intermediate.summary: For testers with CTFL or one to three years of experience who want to be strong test analysts. Covers test analysis and coverage, combinatorial techniques, use case and scenario testing, exploratory testing with session-based management, usability and accessibility testing by hand, web and mobile manual testing, API checks with Postman, SQL for testers, testing in agile teams, regression selection, test management tools, defect triage and root cause analysis, non-functional awareness, ERP testing, user acceptance testing, metrics and ISTQB Advanced Test Analyst preparation.
prerequisites: Holds CTFL or has equivalent knowledge
Has tested real applications by hand
Writes test cases and defect reports confidently
outcomes: Analyse requirements and design tests with advanced techniques and clear coverage
Test web, mobile, API and data behaviour by hand with the right tools
Work as a test analyst in agile teams and support user acceptance testing
Prepare for the ISTQB Advanced Test Analyst exam

days.topic: Test Analysis in Depth: Test Basis, Conditions and Coverage
subtopics: Finding defects in the test basis
Levels of detail in test conditions
days.lab_task: Analyse a requirements set for a loan application, log defects in the requirements, derive and prioritise test conditions and report planned coverage.
days.deliverable: Requirements defects, test conditions and coverage report
checks: At least five requirement defects are logged
Conditions are ordered by risk with reasons

days.topic: Domain Testing and Combinatorial Techniques: Pairwise and Classification Trees
subtopics: Each choice and base choice coverage
days.lab_task: Build a classification tree for an insurance quote form, generate pairwise combinations with constraints and compare the number of tests with full combinations.
days.deliverable: Classification tree, pairwise set and comparison
checks: The tree covers all relevant classes
Test counts for pairwise and full combinations are reported

days.topic: Use Case and Scenario-Based Testing in Depth
subtopics: Use cases, main flows and alternative flows
days.lab_task: Derive tests from use cases for a booking system covering main, alternative and exception flows, and write three end-to-end business scenarios with a business user.
days.deliverable: Use case tests and business scenarios
checks: Every flow has at least one test
Scenarios are reviewed by a business user
Scenarios are run with results recorded

days.topic: Exploratory Testing with Charters and Session-Based Test Management
subtopics: Exploratory testing as a skilled activity
days.lab_task: Plan and run four exploratory sessions with charters and heuristics, debrief each with a lead, and report coverage, findings and time spent.
days.deliverable: Session sheets, debrief notes and a summary report
checks: Each session has a focused charter
The summary shows coverage, defects and time

days.topic: Usability Testing for Manual Testers
days.lab_task: Run a heuristic evaluation of the course application, then a small usability test with three users and report the top problems with severity and evidence.
days.deliverable: Heuristic evaluation and usability test report
checks: Three users complete tasks with observations recorded
Problems are rated by severity with evidence

days.topic: Manual Accessibility Testing Against WCAG 2.2
subtopics: Screen reader testing with NVDA or VoiceOver
days.lab_task: Test five pages of the course application with the keyboard, a screen reader and a contrast checker, compare with an automated scan and report defects with WCAG references.
days.deliverable: Accessibility test results and defect reports
checks: Keyboard and screen reader results are recorded for five pages
Issues missed by the automated scan are listed

days.topic: Testing Web Applications by Hand: Browsers, Devices and Responsive Layouts
days.lab_task: Test the course application across three browsers and four screen sizes, use developer tools to find console errors and failed requests, and report cross-browser defects.
days.deliverable: Coverage matrix, defect reports and web checklist
checks: The matrix shows results for each browser and size
Console errors and failed requests are reported
The checklist covers layout, network and session checks

days.topic: Mobile Manual Testing: Gestures, Interrupts and Device Variety
subtopics: Native, hybrid and mobile web apps
Interrupts: calls, notifications and low battery
tools: Android and iOS test devices or emulators
days.lab_task: Test a mobile app on two Android and one iOS device for gestures, interrupts, offline behaviour and permissions, and report defects with screen recordings.
days.deliverable: Mobile test results and defect reports
checks: Results are recorded for three devices
Calls, notifications and network loss are tested
Defects include device, OS version and recordings

days.topic: API Checks for Manual Testers with Postman
subtopics: Why manual testers need API skills
Finding defects hidden by the UI
days.lab_task: Capture the API calls behind three UI features, repeat them in Postman with valid and invalid data and report any defect the UI hides.
days.deliverable: Postman requests and API defect reports
checks: The API calls behind three features are identified
Valid and invalid requests are tested
Hidden defects are reported with request and response
objectives: Check APIs as a manual tester

days.topic: Database and Data Validation with SQL for Testers
subtopics: Safe use of SQL in test environments
days.lab_task: Perform UI actions in the course application and verify the stored data with SQL queries, including joins and totals, and report one data defect.
days.deliverable: SQL verification queries and a data defect report
checks: Queries return the records created through the UI
Related data is checked with joins
The data defect report includes the query and results

days.topic: Testing in Agile Teams: Three Amigos, Refinement and Sprint Testing
subtopics: The tester's role in a Scrum team
days.lab_task: Take part in a simulated sprint: run a three amigos session, test stories during the sprint, pair with a developer on one story and report testing in the sprint review.
days.deliverable: Three amigos notes, sprint test notes and review summary
checks: The three amigos session adds acceptance examples
Each story is tested before the sprint ends
The review summary states what was tested and residual risk
objectives: Work as a tester in agile teams

days.topic: Regression Test Selection and Maintenance
subtopics: Core, extended and full regression sets
days.lab_task: Review a regression suite of one hundred cases, remove obsolete ones, create core and extended sets and select tests for a change using impact analysis.
days.deliverable: Cleaned regression suite and change-based selection
checks: Obsolete cases are removed with reasons
Core and extended sets are defined

days.topic: Test Management Tools: Jira, Xray and TestRail
subtopics: Test cases, test sets and test plans
Linking tests to stories and defects
days.lab_task: Set up a test project in Jira with Xray or in TestRail, import test cases, run a test cycle linked to stories and defects and build a status dashboard.
days.deliverable: Configured test project with a cycle and dashboard
checks: Tests are grouped into sets and plans
Tests link to stories and defects
The dashboard shows progress and defects

days.topic: Defect Triage and Root Cause Analysis
subtopics: Root cause analysis methods: five whys and fishbone
days.lab_task: Run a role-played triage of fifteen defects, analyse the root causes of three escaped defects with five whys and fishbone diagrams and propose prevention actions.
days.deliverable: Triage decisions, root cause analyses and prevention actions
checks: Each defect has a decision and owner
Three analyses reach process or requirement causes
Each cause has a prevention action

days.topic: Non-Functional Testing for Test Analysts: Performance, Security and Reliability Awareness
subtopics: Writing non-functional requirements that can be tested
days.lab_task: Rewrite five vague non-functional requirements so they can be tested, design simple checks for each and identify which need specialist performance or security testing.
days.deliverable: Testable requirements, checks and specialist test list
checks: Each requirement has a test approach
Specialist testing needs are listed with reasons

days.topic: Testing ERP and Business Process Applications
subtopics: End-to-end process testing such as order to cash
days.lab_task: Test an order-to-cash process across modules in a sample business application with three roles, including master data checks and one integration point.
days.deliverable: Process test cases, results and defects
checks: Each process step is tested in order
Each role can only do its allowed steps
The integration point passes data correctly

days.topic: User Acceptance Testing: Planning and Supporting Business Users
subtopics: Entry and exit criteria for UAT
days.lab_task: Plan a UAT phase for a release, prepare scenarios and data with business users, run a role-played UAT session and handle a disputed defect through to sign-off.
days.deliverable: UAT plan, scenarios, session notes and sign-off
checks: Entry and exit criteria and schedule are agreed
Users complete scenarios with the prepared data

days.topic: Test Metrics and Reporting for Test Analysts
days.lab_task: Build a test status report for a release with coverage, defect and progress metrics, tailor versions for a developer and a sponsor and identify one misleading metric.
days.deliverable: Two tailored reports and a metric critique
checks: Coverage, defects and progress are reported

days.topic: CTAL Test Analyst Exam Preparation and Practice Questions
subtopics: The ISTQB Advanced Test Analyst syllabus
Technique questions at K3 and K4
days.lab_task: Answer a set of CTAL Test Analyst practice questions under time limits, review errors by syllabus chapter and plan revision for the weakest areas.
days.deliverable: Practice results, error log and revision plan
checks: The practice set is completed within time

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Risk-Based Test Campaign for a Release
days.lab_task: Lead the testing of a release in a simulation: analyse risks, design tests with advanced techniques, run scripted and exploratory testing including API and accessibility checks, triage defects, report status and support UAT to sign-off.
days.deliverable: Complete release test campaign artefacts
checks: Test effort follows the risk analysis
Important defects are found and triaged

advanced.summary: For test leads, test managers and QA managers, aligned with ISTQB Advanced Test Management. Covers test strategy and policy, test management at programme level, risk-based testing at scale, estimation, managing test teams, process improvement with TMMi and TPI NEXT, defect management at scale, review programmes, distributed and outsourced testing, environments and releases, regulated testing, shift-left and shift-right, automation business cases, quality reporting, AI in testing, crowd testing, a testing centre of excellence and CTAL Test Management preparation.
prerequisites: Leads testing for a team or project
Holds CTFL and has several years of testing experience
Has planned and reported testing for releases
outcomes: Write test strategies, policies and master test plans for programmes
Lead test teams, estimate and manage testing with risk and metrics
Improve test processes and decide what to automate
Prepare for the ISTQB Advanced Test Management exam

days.topic: Test Strategy and Test Policy for an Organisation
subtopics: Strategy types: analytical, model-based, methodical, reactive and others
days.lab_task: Write a test policy and a test strategy for a case organisation with three product types, and present it to role-played business and engineering leaders.
days.deliverable: Test policy, strategy and presentation notes
checks: The strategy links testing to business goals
Each product type has a suitable approach

days.topic: Test Management in Depth: Planning, Monitoring and Control at Programme Level
subtopics: Master test plans and level plans
days.lab_task: Write a master test plan for a three-project programme, run a simulated monitoring cycle with a slipped milestone and decide control actions for the programme board.
days.deliverable: Master test plan, monitoring report and control decisions
checks: The plan covers levels, dependencies and milestones
The report shows status across all projects
Control actions address the slipped milestone

days.topic: Risk-Based Testing at Scale: Product Risk Workshops and Mitigation
days.lab_task: Facilitate a role-played product risk workshop, build the risk register, map test effort to risk levels and produce a residual risk report at release time.
days.deliverable: Workshop notes, risk register and residual risk report
checks: Risks come from several stakeholder groups
Test effort is proportional to risk level
The release report states remaining risks

days.topic: Test Estimation Techniques: Wideband Delphi, Metrics-Based and Three-Point
days.lab_task: Estimate testing for a release with Wideband Delphi in a group, metrics-based estimation from historical data and three-point estimation, and present a range with assumptions.
days.deliverable: Three estimates and a presented range
checks: The final estimate is a range with confidence

days.topic: Managing Test Teams: Skills, Hiring and Motivation
days.lab_task: Assess a case test team's skills, design an interview exercise for a test analyst role, write development plans for two testers and handle a role-played conflict.
days.deliverable: Skills assessment, interview kit and development plans
checks: Skills gaps are identified for the team
The interview exercise tests analysis and communication
Each plan has goals and activities

days.topic: Test Process Improvement: TMMi and TPI NEXT
days.lab_task: Assess a case organisation's testing against TMMi or TPI NEXT, prioritise three improvements and write an improvement plan with measures.
days.deliverable: Assessment results and improvement plan
checks: Three improvements are chosen with reasons
Each improvement has a measure and target

days.topic: Defect Management at Scale: Metrics, Trends and Prevention
days.lab_task: Analyse a year of defect data for a programme, calculate detection percentage and trends, find two systemic causes and present a prevention programme.
days.deliverable: Defect analysis and prevention programme
checks: Metrics and trends are calculated correctly
Two systemic causes are supported by data
The programme has actions, owners and measures

days.topic: Reviews at Scale: Formal Inspections and Review Programmes
subtopics: Choosing review types for work products
days.lab_task: Run a formal inspection of a design document with roles and metrics, then design a review programme for an organisation that does few reviews.
days.deliverable: Inspection record and review programme design
checks: The inspection follows the process with roles
The programme states which artefacts get which review

days.topic: Testing Outsourced and Distributed Projects
subtopics: Contracts and service levels for testing
Communication across companies and time zones
days.lab_task: Set up testing with an external vendor for a case project: define service levels, a communication plan and a vendor scorecard, and review a month of simulated vendor results.
days.deliverable: Service levels, communication plan and vendor review
checks: The plan covers meetings, reports and escalation
The review uses the scorecard and sets actions

days.topic: Test Environment and Release Management for Testing
days.lab_task: Plan test environments for a programme, resolve two booking conflicts, run a readiness check before a test cycle and define release readiness criteria.
days.deliverable: Environment plan, readiness check and release criteria
checks: Each test level has the environment it needs
Both conflicts are resolved with stakeholders

days.topic: Compliance and Regulated Testing: Audit Trails and Validation
subtopics: Testing in regulated industries: banking, pharma, medical and automotive
days.lab_task: Prepare validation evidence for a regulated feature with a validation plan, traceability and signed test results, then face a role-played audit and respond to findings.
days.deliverable: Validation pack and audit response
checks: Every requirement traces to signed results
Auditor questions are answered from the evidence
Findings have corrective actions and dates

days.topic: Shift-Left and Shift-Right Testing Practices
days.lab_task: Design shift-left practices for requirements and design, and shift-right practices for a release with canaries and monitoring, for a case team, and present the change plan.
days.deliverable: Shift-left and shift-right practice plan
checks: At least three practices move testing earlier
Production checks are safe and monitored
The plan includes adoption steps and measures

days.topic: Deciding What to Automate: Business Cases for Test Automation
days.lab_task: Analyse a manual regression suite, choose automation candidates, build a business case with costs, benefits and payback, and plan a pilot.
days.deliverable: Candidate list, business case and pilot plan
checks: Candidates are chosen by frequency, stability and value
The business case shows payback with assumptions
The pilot has scope and success criteria

days.topic: Quality Reporting to Stakeholders and Release Readiness
subtopics: What stakeholders need from quality reports
days.lab_task: Prepare a release readiness review with a quality dashboard and a go or no-go recommendation for a release with open defects, and present it to role-played stakeholders.
days.deliverable: Readiness review pack and recommendation
checks: The dashboard shows coverage, defects and risk
The recommendation is justified by evidence
Residual risks are accepted or actions agreed

days.topic: AI for Test Managers: Test Generation, Risk and Testing AI Systems
subtopics: AI tools for test design and test case generation
AI for defect analysis and prioritisation
Testing AI and machine learning systems
Governance for AI use in testing
days.lab_task: Use an AI assistant to generate test cases for a feature and review their quality, then plan testing for an AI-based recommendation feature including bias and robustness checks.
days.deliverable: Reviewed AI-generated tests and an AI system test plan
checks: Quality issues in generated tests are recorded
The plan covers bias, robustness and data quality
Rules for AI use in testing are written

days.topic: Crowd Testing and Beta Programmes
days.lab_task: Plan a crowd test for a mobile app release with a brief and device coverage, triage a set of simulated crowd results and design a small beta programme.
days.deliverable: Crowd test brief, triage results and beta plan
checks: The brief defines scope, devices and reporting rules
Duplicates and invalid reports are filtered
The beta plan covers recruitment, feedback and exit

days.topic: Building a Testing Centre of Excellence
subtopics: Purpose and services of a testing centre of excellence
Supporting teams without becoming a bottleneck
days.lab_task: Design a testing centre of excellence for a case organisation with services, standards, a training and certification path and measures, and present it to leadership.
days.deliverable: Centre of excellence plan and presentation
checks: Services and engagement model are described
The training path covers roles and ISTQB levels
objectives: Build a testing centre of excellence

days.topic: CTAL Test Management Exam Preparation
subtopics: The ISTQB Advanced Test Management syllabus
Scenario questions on planning and risk
Calculation questions on estimation and metrics
days.lab_task: Answer a timed set of CTAL Test Management practice questions, review errors by chapter and plan revision for the weakest areas before booking the exam.
days.deliverable: Practice results, error log and revision plan
checks: The set is completed within time

days.topic: Troubleshooting Failing Test Projects
subtopics: Signs a test project is failing
Common causes: scope, environments, skills and late code
days.lab_task: Diagnose a failing test project from metrics and role-played interviews, choose recovery options and present a recovery plan to the sponsor.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis and recovery plan
checks: Causes are supported by metrics and interviews
The sponsor accepts the plan or sets conditions

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Test Strategy and Master Test Plan for a Programme
days.lab_task: For a detailed programme case, write the test strategy and master test plan, run a risk workshop, design the team and vendor model, define metrics and present everything to a mock programme board.
days.deliverable: Strategy, master test plan, risk register and board presentation
checks: Strategy and master plan are consistent with risks
The team and vendor model covers all test levels
The board approves or sets specific conditions
